subject: OrbitPOS auto-accept feature not functioning for online orders
description: The automatic order acceptance feature in OrbitPOS v2.0 has stopped working at the Dadar location. Online orders placed through our platform are no longer being auto-accepted and are stuck in pending status, requiring manual intervention. This is causing delays in order fulfillment and impacting customer experience. The issue began this morning around 11:30 AM. Store staff have attempted refreshing the system but the problem persists.

ticket_history.note: Ticket acknowledged. Confirmed that auto-accept setting is enabled in system configuration. Advised store manager to check network connectivity and POS terminal status while investigation continues.
